label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Marketing Funnel Explained
body: A marketing funnel describes the path potential customers take from first learning about your offering to becoming a paying customer.
caption:
Think of it like a path: at the top, many people discover your work, maybe through a blog post or social media. As they move down, fewer but more interested people engage, perhaps by signing up for your newsletter. Finally, a small group makes a purchase.
